summary_en: This Phase 1 study tests D3S-003 in adults with advanced solid tumors that have a KRAS p.G12D mutation. The drug is taken by mouth as a tablet, in one arm once daily and in another twice daily; how long treatment lasts is not stated. The study measures safety, tolerability, pharmacokinetics, pharmacodynamics, and preliminary efficacy in this first-in-human, open-label, dose-escalation trial.
summary_es: Este estudio de fase 1 evalúa D3S-003 en adultos con tumores sólidos avanzados que tienen una mutación KRAS p.G12D. El medicamento se toma por vía oral en tableta, en un grupo una vez al día y en otro dos veces al día; la duración del tratamiento no se indica. El estudio mide la seguridad, la tolerabilidad, la farmacocinética, la farmacodinamia y la eficacia preliminar en este ensayo abierto de escalada de dosis en humanos por primera vez.
who_for: Locally advanced, recurrent, or metastatic cancer that did not respond to adequate standard treatment, or with no effective standard treatment available.
KRAS p.G12D mutation found by a local test on tumor tissue or blood collected within the last 5 years.
Measurable disease according to RECIST v1.1.
Adequate organ and marrow function during screening.
not_for: Prior treatment with a specific KRAS G12D inhibitor or degrader, or a pan RAS inhibitor or degrader.
